name: YOOPAI
summary: Amazon/eBay-first brand selling budget PLA, Silk PLA and PETG on Bambu/Creality-compatible 1 kg spools alongside FilamentBox filament dryers and storage accessories. The USPTO trademark is reportedly held by Shenzhen Anmaisi Technology Co., Ltd.; who extrudes the filament is unknown.

product_lines.name: FilamentBox dryer / storage
product_lines.notes: Accessory hardware (FilamentBox 4 dryer, connectors), not filament.

additional_notes: Owner Shenzhen Anmaisi Technology Co., Ltd. confirmed on the Justia trademark records (serials 90418638 / 90418649, Class 7 and Class 11; TSDR itself returned 500). The filings cover machines and appliances, not filament, which hints at outsourced filament but is not evidence of a specific OEM, so no relationship is encoded. The same Qianhai registered-office address is used by Shenzhen Chensi Trading (owner of the UJOYBIO mark); treated as an address coincidence. Heavy Amazon variation listings (owner counted 274).

provenance.conflicts: Justia records read 2026-11-06: both YOOPAI marks (90418638 Class 7, 90418649 Class 11, registered 2021-10-19) are owned by Shenzhen Anmaisi Technology Co., Ltd., Rm 201, Bldg A, No. 1 Qianwan 1st Rd, Qianhai, Shenzhen. Neither class covers filament. SimplyPrint's 'brand from USA' claim is unsupported. Manufacturing country unknown.
